en: Matthew 27

p.src: 1  Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

en: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

en: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
u.src: 2  They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

en: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

en: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

en: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

zh: 耶穌在彼拉多面前受審

p.src: 11  Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

en: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

en: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
u.src: 12  When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

p.src: 13  Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

en: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

p.src: 14  He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

en: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.
u.src: 14  He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

p.src: 15  Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

en: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

en: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

p.src: 17  When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

en: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

en: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
u.src: 18  For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

p.src: 19  While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

en: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

en: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

p.src: 21  But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

en: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
u.src: 21  But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

p.src: 22  Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

en: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

p.src: 23  But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

en: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

p.src: 24  So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

en: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

en: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

p.src: 26  Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

en: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

p.src: 27  Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

en: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

en: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
